title: Mitigating Video Hallucinations via Attention-Guided Representation Perturbation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video large language models (Video LLMs) often generate responses unsupported by the input video. Contrastive decoding (CD) can mitigate these hallucinations, but its effectiveness depends on how the negative branch weakens visual evidence. Existing methods rely on predefined perturbations or masking guided by question reconstruction, offering limited control over the model's visual reliance during answer generation. We introduce Attention-guided Representation Perturbation for Contrastive Decoding (ARP-CD), a training-free framework for constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space. ARP-CD uses the attention mass assigned to visual tokens at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates of the language model's input visual hidden states. These updates reduce visual attention and produce a negative input, whose predictions are contrasted with those of the original branch throughout generation. E

translated_title: 通过注意力引导的表示扰动缓解视频幻觉
translated_abstract: 视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）经常生成输入视频无法支持的回答。对比解码（Contrastive Decoding, CD）可以缓解这类幻觉，但其有效性取决于负分支如何削弱视觉证据。现有方法依赖于预定义的扰动或由问题重构引导的掩码操作，对模型在答案生成过程中的视觉依赖控制能力有限。我们提出了注意力引导表示扰动的对比解码方法（ARP-CD），这是一个无需训练的框架，可直接在表示空间中构建对比负样本。ARP-CD利用答案预测位置分配给视觉token的注意力权重，来引导对语言模型输入视觉隐状态的有界梯度更新。这些更新会降低视觉注意力并产生一个负输入，在整个生成过程中，该负输入的预测与原始分支的预测进行对比，从而缓解幻觉问题。
tldr: 提出了ARP-CD，一种无需训练的对比解码框架，通过利用答案生成时的注意力权重引导对视觉隐状态的梯度更新来构建对比负样本，从而有效缓解视频大语言模型的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes ARP-CD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that mitigates video hallucinations by using attention weights at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates on visual hidden states, constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space.
